I'm walking into the class with the sound of the same 10-15 measures of a piece being played,

I make my way to my seat next to my stand partner, and sit down.

 

 3    First thing I notice about everyone who is playing is that they're awful. Just dreadful.

 I mean it was hilarious, but I have to play with these people.

Like they were a machine with disgustingly bad programming.

 

4     Their fingers were like lightning; couldn't strike the same damn place twice.

in a class of 60 people - 60 People; That's Huge for a highschool orchestra

At least half of them should sound like they've played an instrument before, or for that matter,

like they've used their hands before.

 

5     NOBODY Practiced! They were given such a fair amount of time, and even a fairly easy piece.

just a bunch of half notes and quarter notes! I feel so bad because I'm not even that good of a player.

But I might just end up being the best in my section.

  

 

6     And out of the maybe 30 ish we managed to get through that day 2 or 3 were decent.

I feel awful about my future in this class.

At least I can hope for the untested students

We have a three day weekend so I'm really hoping the remaining kids can get their act together and practice.

 

TL;DR

Almost my entire orchestra sucked during their playing tests that they had time to practice for.

I can only hope that the ones we didn't get to test (myself included) can make up for how bad they were.
